messages.content: 計算兩個電荷為5C和7C，相距3米時的電磁力。

function.name: electromagnetic_force
function.description: Calculate the electromagnetic force between two charges placed at a certain distance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

charge1.description: The magnitude of the first charge in coulombs.

charge2.description: The magnitude of the second charge in coulombs.

distance.description: The distance between the two charges in meters.

medium_permittivity.description: The relative permittivity of the medium in which the charges are present. Default is 8.854e-12 (Vacuum Permittivity). This is a float type value.

message.reasoning: The user wants to calculate the electromagnetic force between two charges of 5C and 7C separated by 3 meters. They want the calculation. The tool available is "electromagnetic_force" which calculates the electromagnetic force between two charges placed at a certain distance. The user didn't specify the medium permittivity, so we can use the default vacuum permittivity 8.854e-12. The function signature: electromagnetic_force({charge1: number, charge2: number, distance: number, medium_permittivity?: number}). So we need to call the function with charge1=5, charge2=7, distance=3. The medium_permittivity is optional; we can omit it or set to default. The function will return the result. Then we need to respond with the result. The user asked: "計算兩個電荷為5C和7C，相距3米時的電磁力。" So we should call the function.
